data.title: School — Starter · Lesson 2
data.subject: school
data.lyrics:
[Intro]
Alright now, it's a rainy day…

[Hook]
Hello… Hola
Good morning… Buenos días
Let's learn… Vamos a aprender
One, two, three… Uno, dos, tres
Come sing with me today.

[Verse]
The rain is falling, tap, tap, tap,
We stay inside, no need to nap.
Enter the classroom… Entrar al aula
Open the book… Abrir el libro
Use the pencil sharpener… Usar el sacapuntas
Write on the board… Escribir en la pizarra
Listen to the teacher… Escuchar al profesor
Ask for permission… Pedir permiso
Participate in class… Participar en clase
Put away supplies… Guardar los útiles
The student learns… El estudiante aprende
In the school… En la escuela

[Hook]
Hello… Hola
Good morning… Buenos días
Let's learn… Vamos a aprender
One, two, three… Uno, dos, tres
Come sing with me today.

[Verse]
The clock is ticking, time to grow,
Knowledge is power, let it show.
Enter the classroom… Entrar al aula
Open the book… Abrir el libro
Use the pencil sharpener… Usar el sacapuntas
